user.title: AVS cloud account
user.description: Enter the credentials used in Mio Antifurto. Device ID is optional: reuse the probe ID to avoid registering another device.

data_description.device_id: 16 lowercase hexadecimal characters. Leave empty to generate a stable ID.

plant.title: Installation and PIN
plant.description: Sign in with the central panel PIN. Choose whether to require it for commands in Home Assistant too. Signing in can register a device in the AVS account.

data.require_command_pin: Require PIN to arm and disarm

data_description.require_command_pin: When disabled, anyone allowed to control this panel in Home Assistant can arm and disarm without entering a PIN. The panel PIN is still required for the AVS connection.

reauth_confirm.title: Update AVS credentials
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the account credentials and central panel PIN for the configured installation.

error.invalid_auth: Authentication refused. Check account credentials and PIN in the AVS app.
error.invalid_pin: Enter a numeric PIN. Leading zeros are preserved.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot read the installation. Check connectivity and try again later.
error.account_error: AVS account needs attention: check subscription, device limit or consent in the official app.
error.protocol_error: The AVS cloud returned an unexpected response. Check the Nova Alarm logs for the diagnostic code.
error.too_many_users: AVS reports too many concurrent sessions. Close other sessions if present and try again later.
error.rate_limited: The AVS cloud is limiting requests. Wait before retrying.
error.timeout: The AVS cloud did not respond in time. Check the Nova Alarm logs.
error.tls_error: The HTTPS connection to AVS could not be verified. Check Home Assistant date, time and connectivity; do not disable certificate verification.
error.panel_unreachable: The AVS cloud reports that the panel is unreachable or was not found. Check the Nova Alarm logs.
error.session_error: AVS rejected the session even after renewal. Check the Nova Alarm logs.

abort.plant_not_found: This account does not contain the configured installation.

init.title: Updates and mode mapping
init.description: Select the arming modes to show: select only ON if that is all you use. OFF remains available. Mapping determines states and commands; use distinct HA states for selected modes. Hiding a mode does not change panel configuration.

data.require_command_pin: Require PIN to arm and disarm

data_description.require_command_pin: When disabled, anyone allowed to control this panel in Home Assistant can arm and disarm without entering a PIN. The panel PIN is still required for the AVS connection.

error.duplicate_modes: Assign a different HA state to each selected mode.

invalid_code.message: Enter the central panel PIN configured in the integration, preserving leading zeros.

ambiguous_mode.message: Mode is missing or ambiguous. Configure a unique mapping in the integration options.

mode_not_allowed.message: This mode is not permitted for this sector or its state is unavailable.

command_rejected.message: The panel refused the command or the operation is not permitted. Check zones, faults and permissions in the official app.

command_failed.message: Command delivery is unconfirmed. Check the state in the official app before retrying. The command was not automatically retried. Check the Nova Alarm logs for the diagnostic cause.

command_unconfirmed.message: Command accepted, but the requested state is not yet confirmed by the panel. Wait for an update and check the official app before retrying.

zone_not_editable.message: The zone is active or its state is unavailable. Change exclusions while the system is disarmed.
